title: NullSubschemaMapRoot
description: The same null-typed sub-schema at the other overflow position: an object with no declared properties at all, whose whole shape is a schema-valued additionalProperties. It needs a document of its own because the position only exists when nothing else names a key, and it is reached by a different arm than the struct-with-properties one -- generatePropertylessObjectDef rather than generateStructDef -- so a fix to either says nothing about the other. Issue #222.
